info.name: HW06 API 1 - FR-01 Account Registration
info.description: Software Testing HW06. Audited + human-extended executable suite for POST /api/register. Every request receives X-Student-Id from the collection-level pre-request script.

exec: const sid = pm.environment.get("studentId") || "23127531";
pm.request.headers.upsert({ key: "X-Student-Id", value: sid });
console.log(`[HW06] ${pm.info.requestName} | X-Student-Id: ${sid}`);

request.description: Audited executable case.

exec: pm.test("Status is 200", function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });

pm.test("Success schema matches specification", function () { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j).to.have.property("message", "User registered successfully"); pm.expect(j).to.have.property("id"); pm.expect(j.id).to.be.a("number"); });

pm.test("No password or internal fields are exposed", function () { const j = pm.response.json(); ["password","role","login_attempts","locked_until","reset_token"].forEach(k => pm.expect(j).to.not.have.property(k)); });

request.description: Mass-assignment security test.

exec: pm.test("Registration succeeds", function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });

pm.test("Client role cannot escalate privileges", function (done) { pm.sendRequest({url: pm.environment.get("baseUrl") + "/api/login", method:"POST", header:{"Content-Type":"application/json","X-Student-Id":pm.environment.get("studentId")}, body:{mode:"raw", raw:JSON.stringify({email:"hw06.reg037@example.com",password:"Password123!"})}}, function(err,res){ pm.expect(err).to.equal(null); pm.expect(res.code).to.equal(200); const j=res.json(); pm.expect(j.user.role).to.equal("user"); done(); }); });
pm.test("Registration succeeds", function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });
pm.test("Client cannot force server-generated id", function () { const j=pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.id).to.not.equal(999999); });
pm.test("SQL payload does not cause server error", function () { pm.expect(pm.response.code).to.be.below(500); });
pm.test("No SQL error details are exposed", function () { pm.expect(pm.response.text().toLowerCase()).to.not.include("syntax error"); });

request.description: Human-added mass-assignment test based on reviewed users table schema.

exec: pm.test("Registration succeeds", function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });

pm.test("Sensitive server-owned account fields are ignored", function (done) { pm.sendRequest({url: pm.environment.get("baseUrl") + "/api/login", method:"POST", header:{"Content-Type":"application/json","X-Student-Id":pm.environment.get("studentId")}, body:{mode:"raw", raw:JSON.stringify({email:"hw06.hum006@example.com",password:"Password123!"})}}, function(err,res){ pm.expect(err).to.equal(null); pm.expect(res.code).to.equal(200); const u=res.json().user; pm.expect(u.login_attempts).to.not.equal(99); pm.expect(u.locked_until).to.not.equal("2099-01-01T00:00:00Z"); pm.expect(u.reset_token).to.not.equal("attacker-token"); done(); }); });
